FIELDS.NAME: Reliable Plumbing & HVAC Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Reliable Plumbing & HVAC Solutions, we specialize in providing high-quality plumbing and HVAC services to residential and light commercial properties. Our core operations include the installation, maintenance, and repair of heating systems, air conditioning units, and plumbing fixtures, ensuring they meet all local, state, and federal safety and building codes. We pride ourselves on our commitment to customer satisfaction and safety, implementing a proactive safety program that includes regular employee training and equipment maintenance. Our team consists of licensed technicians who adhere strictly to regulatory standards, assuring clients of our competency and reliability. We also utilize subcontractors for specialized tasks, ensuring they carry appropriate insurance and follow indemnification agreements to protect against potential liabilities. Our operations are focused on low- and medium-risk environments, allowing us to minimize operational risks while providing excellent service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On February 10, 2023, we experienced a loss due to a water leak during a plumbing installation at a residential property, which damaged the flooring. The estimated cost of the damage was $2,500. The status of the claim is currently closed as repairs were completed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday: 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM, Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around job sites for enhanced safety and protection against theft.

We focus solely on plumbing and HVAC services for residential and light commercial properties, adhering to all safety regulations and standards.
